about_the_game:
*Images are from an in-development game build.

"Holo's Hanafuda" is a video game that brings together Japan's traditional hanafuda card games and the popular Japanese female VTuber group "Hololive”.

🎴What is "Hanafuda" ?🎴

Hanafuda, meaning "flower cards," are traditional Japanese playing cards featuring beautiful seasonal imagery across 12 monthly suits. Hanafuda cards have a long tradition in Japan and are beloved by people of all ages. In fact, Nintendo originally started as a hanafuda card manufacturing company.

🎴Game Features🎴

Beginner-Friendly Assist Mode

"Assist Mode" simplifies play with on-screen markers and tips, making it easy to play hanafuda without memorizing card values and rules.

Story Mode with Hololive Characters

An immersive narrative adventure where Hololive members enter a world inspired by hanafuda card imagery. Learn gameplay while enjoying character interactions and storylines.

Create and Share Homemade Bento Boxes

Use points collected through gameplay to unlock a wider variety of ingredients for your bento boxes. Design custom meals with these materials and exchange your culinary creations with other players online!

🎴Characters🎴

😈Nakiri Ayame

“Greetings, Humans! Yoohoo!”

A kimono-clad Oni girl from the Underworld Academy. As she loves to prank people, she always uses will-o’-the-wisp on them just to have fun. Many may not realize it, but she is actually the president of the student council.

🌽Shirakami Fubuki

“Good foxy day! I'm Shirakami Fubuki!”

White-haired animal-eared otaku fox. She loves talking with people and will be happy if you give her the time of day.

She aims to become a top otaku idol while enjoying each and every day.

🌲Ookami Mio

“Hellooowl! It is Ookami Mio!”

A black-haired wolf girl who appeared on our radar randomly. She often shows up around shrines. She likes gaming.

🌸Sakura Miko

“Nya-hello~! I'm Sakura Miko, an elite shrine maiden-idol!”

A shrine maiden from the Virtual Sakura Shrine. With a vivid admiration for idols, she constantly pushes herself to greater heights to become a top elite shrine maiden-idol like no other!

Well... a self-proclaimed 'elite,' to be exact. Fans would think "clutz" fits her better...

...and more!

🎴Story🎴

Hololive members find themselves drawn into a mysterious world depicted on Hanafuda cards. Meet companions along the way as you challenge enemies through Hanafuda matches. Enjoy the original story featuring the Hololive members.
